replies.body: Done — `muzzle-check.gradle.kts` now reads `latest-dep-versions.json` and caps open-ended version ranges (e.g. `[4.1,)` → `[4.1,<pinned>]`). Falls back to the original unbounded range if no pinned version exists for the artifact. Also updated `docs/safety-mechanisms.md` to document both the test-latest-deps pinning and the muzzle capping.

Update: the initial string-based range capping had issues with pre-release versions (`6.0-rc2` < `6.0` in Maven ordering) and cross-major pinned versions (e.g. pinned `7.17.19` but range `[8.10,)`). Switched to post-resolution filtering — Aether resolves the full range, then `filterVersions()` excludes versions above the pinned upper bound using `Version.compareTo()`. All 4 muzzle jobs pass now.
Already implemented — updated lookup key to use `#+` suffix.
